name: segment_mesh
description: Segments an existing mesh into named sub-parts using AI. Requires a source MeshPart or Model and up to 5 comma-separated part names (e.g. "head, body, tail"). Returns a new Model containing the segmented parts, inserted as a sibling of the source.

parts.description: Comma-separated list of part names to segment the mesh into (max 5). Example: "head, body, tail".

selectedInstanceRef.description: The source mesh: an InstanceRef pointing to a MeshPart or to a Model containing the mesh to segment.

uniqueId.description: Unique instance id of the source MeshPart or Model.

studio_id.description: Selects Roblox Studio instance, use the list_roblox_studios tool to get available instances
